ModMetadata.Author: FlorpyDorp + JXSN
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]Stationeers UI Mod[/h1]
Radial inventory and HUD overhaul for Stationeers (procedural Unity UGUI radials + ImGui HUD). Toolbelt, tool, bag radials, SmartStow+, visor HUD, equipment keys. Client-side optional mod. [h3]POC integrated as Unity mod base[/h3]
ModMetadata.InGameDescription:
Stationeers UI Mod WARNING: This is a StationeersLaunchPad Plugin Mod. It requires BepInEx + StationeersLaunchPad.
Stationeers UI Mod — Radials for tools/bags, SmartStow+, two-hand visor HUD. Replaces hotbar friction with modern interaction while keeping physical inventory rules.

Ported from BepInEx proof-of-concept into Unity mod project. Radials are now drawn with a fully procedural Unity UGUI renderer (code-built canvas + runtime mesh wedges).
ModMetadata.ChangeLog: [h3]Version 0.8.0 — GLASSY + THE DESIGNER, DEEPER:[/h3] [list] [*] New shipped look: the "Glassy" car-dashboard HUD (procedural glass boxes, the game's own ramp-bar gauge art, de-blued restyle) — Glassy 4.0 is the default; your custom profiles are left untouched [*] Moodlets relocated into the bar as centered dashboard chips that bend onto the visor curve, keep their hover tooltips, and hide the vanilla strip — with transparency + brightness sliders [*] Curvature: Mode C's walk-swim is fixed (head-locked to the camera); NEW Mode D gives the curved look with no swim; each element remembers its placement per curvature mode [*] Designer gets deeper: per-element effect toggles + strength (death collapse / glitch / warp), per-tier layout (bare vs suit), global box colours with per-element follow, live Z re-layering, and curved (smooth spline) line-work [*] Bare senses: place any of 8 felt-senses (now incl. Consciousness + Toilet) in any row; health reads as general wellness; hunger/thirst match the vitals card [*] Radials: single/double settings show inline, split-stack wedges, live stats on swap/replace/eject, smarter swipe chevrons, sorting-class colours, and wedge hotkeys that never shadow a game keybind (press the letter again to unbind) [*] Optional power-transition static/distortion effect (reuses the game's CameraFilterPack); PNG body-doll damage colours are editable; crash fix for duplicate moodlet/doll borrows [*] Console: finddead (dead-player body bags) and findlargebox (large cardboard boxes) locators with coordinates [/list] [h3]Version 0.7.0 — THE HUD DESIGNER:[/h3] [list] [*] The whole HUD is now a LAYOUT you own: press F9, click any element — drag it anywhere, resize it by its handles (with a toggleable snap grid), restyle every color per element, change any gauge's data source, flip gauges vertical/horizontal with your own zone colors [*] Draw your own UI: add boxes (each corner's rounding adjustable), your own text labels, icons (26 built-in thin-line glyphs, or drop PNGs in config/StationeersUIMod/HudIcons), and free-drawn line work (click points on screen) [*] Moodlets now appear as small dashboard chips under the top bar, spreading out from the center like a car's warning lights; the vanilla strip is hidden [*] New: body-damage silhouette (7 regions), suit status chips with state dots, vertical instrument cards with target markers, world name / day / active-hand badge elements [*] Layouts autosave as named, shareable profiles (config/StationeersUIMod/HudProfiles); full undo/redo; the shipped default matches the new concept art [*] Vanilla's bottom-right instrument cluster and status strip are hidden through the game's own visibility paths (everything restorable) [/list] [h3]Version 0.6.2:[/h3] [list] [*] Drag a chip out of a radial and drop it straight onto a HAND box or a 1-6 equipment box — it moves into that slot (swaps when occupied, all through the usual multiplayer-safe checks) [*] While you're dragging an item, child radials (slide-out satellites) no longer pop up in the way [*] NEW option (on by default, F10): keep moving with WASD and jump with Space while a radial is open — typing in the search panel never moves you, and it disables while seated [/list] [h3]Version 0.6.1:[/h3] [list] [*] Option B hold mode: resting the cursor on ANY branch wedge (Backpack, a category, a nested bag) now dives into it — hold MMB and hover your way from The Hub all the way to an item, release to grab it [*] Fixed: pressing F9 in a Creative world threw a vanilla NullReferenceException (F9 is also vanilla's spawn-item key and its handler crashes with nothing selected) — the vanilla spawn is now guarded and auto-suppressed while the HUD editor owns F9; with the creative spawn menu open F9 spawns as vanilla intends [/list] [h3]Version 0.6.0:[/h3] [list] [*] Radial Option B — "The Hub": the toolbelt radial (MMB) grows a top-center wedge that branches into everything Tab opens (search + every worn piece) [*] TAP middle mouse = the toolbelt radial opens sticky; tap MMB again on a wedge to select it (branches navigate, actions run and close), tap empty space to dismiss [*] HOLD middle mouse = transient as always: point at The Hub for a beat (or LMB) to dive in, LMB enters bags/categories, RMB backs out, release runs the hovered action and closes [*] Option B keeps ALL of Option A (STOW wedges, satellites, scroll values, search, parking); pick the schema in F10 or the config [/list] [h3]Version 0.5.0:[/h3] [list] [*] The visor HUD: full-screen UGUI replacement built to the concept art — curved top status bar (UTC, pressure, O2, temp, power, water, suit status), compass ribbon with cardinals + degrees, left equipment column (1-6), bottom hand tray, vitals card with the live 3D player as a cyan hologram, visor-edge vignette [*] Diegetic tiers: full readout only with a powered suit; without one you get felt-sense WORDS (WARM, HUNGRY, THIN AIR) that flare on change; the robot always sees everything [*] Suit power death collapses the HUD in a CRT flicker; a powered suit boots it back panel by panel; low battery causes dropout glitches [*] All THREE curvature implementations: A vertex warp, B RenderTexture dome projection (+scanlines), C curved world-space canvas — switchable live [*] F9 HUD editor: click any HUD element on screen to edit its colours/sizes in a popup right there; hover highlights its palette entries; every colour/font/size/behavior knob with Undo/Redo [*] docs/Moodlets-Reference.md: every vanilla status/moodlet with exact triggers [/list] [h3]Version 0.4.0:[/h3] [list] [*] Generic device settings: every setting vanilla's inventory window shows, with vanilla's live labels (jetpack stabilizer, suit A/C / air / filter / pressure / temperature, helmet visor / light / flush) — SETTINGS wedge everywhere by one shared rule [*] Component satellites: slide over a battery / canister / cartridge for TAKE / REPLACE (full swap list) / its settings [*] Tab parity: all six worn pieces (glasses included) open exactly the radial their 1-6 key opens; empty worn slots are STOW wedges [*] Search is a radial now: SEARCH wedge on top with the text box, results fill the bottom half as draggable wedges, wheel pages [*] Z-grab (mouse-mod key): grab world items under the cursor into the radial drag layer; drag-move the whole radial by its hub; CLOSE button at the hub bottom [*] Shift keeps radials open across actions; E swaps hands (indicator stays lit); bag presentation options (grouping toggle, empty-slot modes, max wedges); icons scale with wedges; chip size + shine intensity in the editor [/list] [h3]Version 0.3.0:[/h3] [list] [*] Option A control schema (F10-switchable vs classic Option D): STOW wedges, device-control child radials with scroll-wheel value adjust, take/open satellites on nested bags, auto-close after actions [*] Search all bags: type-to-filter panel; click puts the item in a free hand or drops it at your feet [*] Drag-out parking: press-drag items out of radials onto the screen, drop them into slots, or RMB-out to drop them all [*] Radial editor (F10): black-screen playground with live example radials; every colour, font, size and thickness tunable [*] Full wedge outlines with side borders, wedge gaps and side-edge anti-aliasing; bold RBNo font; live state under icons (battery %, kPa, stack counts) [*] Custom UIA sorting classes (22 classes for 785 items) replace the game's coarse groups in bag radials [/list] [h3]Version 0.2.0:[/h3] [list] [*] Rebased as StationeersUIMod Unity/SLP mod (namespace StationeersUIMod) [*] Procedural Unity UGUI radial renderer (built in code, no prefabs) as primary [*] Hooked to SLP OnLoaded entrypoint; legacy ImGui painter retained for reference [*] All BepInEx plugin code integrated, patches preserved (fail-soft) [/list]
